title: The Third Freedom
subtitle: India's unfinished freedom: from developing to developed nation in one generation
author: Shailesh Gupta
coverAlt: Front cover: The Third Freedom. 1947. 1991. Now. By Shailesh Gupta

blurb.headline: 1947 freed India from foreign rule. 1991 freed it from the licence raj. The third freedom frees every Indian to build.
blurb.body: India has the largest, youngest workforce on earth, and a window that will not stay open for ever. This book is a complete playbook to turn that demographic dividend into a developed nation within one generation, not fifty years: 28 reforms, each with its cost, its legal route, its guardrails and real proof that it already works somewhere in India or abroad.
points: Three simple taxes and no income tax
No licence raj: register and start the same day
Courts with hard deadlines, and a clean, well-paid police
A lean, contract-based state that pays only for results
Every action in the first 30 days or within 1 year
blurb.quote: It is not a question of whether it can be done. It is a question of political will, within one tenure.

sections.title: The Principles
sections.dek: Ten simple ideas run through every chapter of this book. Together they describe a state that trusts its people, moves fast and delivers.

sections.label: Part I
sections.title: Money, Tax and Digital Rails
sections.dek: Chapters 1 to 6: Tax: Keep What You Earn; Every Rupee Digital; Banks for Builders, Safety for Savers; Digital Rails for Every Citizen; Land You Truly Own; Justice on Time.

sections.label: Chapter 1
sections.title: Tax: Keep What You Earn
sections.dek: Abolish income tax and simplify to 3 taxes. Outcome: the same or more revenue from year 2, money moving faster on the bank rails, and a path to double-digit growth.

sections.label: Chapter 2
sections.title: Every Rupee Digital
sections.dek: Go fully digital in 1 year. Outcome: ₹40 lakh crore of idle cash moves into banks, adding about ₹10 lakh crore of new lending.

sections.label: Chapter 3
sections.title: Banks for Builders, Safety for Savers
sections.dek: Digital bank licences in 30 days and weak cooperative banks merged. Outcome: 5 crore newly banked and every insured saver paid in 90 days.

sections.label: Chapter 4
sections.title: Digital Rails for Every Citizen
sections.dek: Run every government service like UPI. Outcome: 99.9% uptime, signal in every village and KYC done once for life.

sections.label: Chapter 5
sections.title: Land You Truly Own
sections.dek: Digitize every land and court record. Outcome: 100% of land records digital in 30 days and state-guaranteed titles in 20 states in 1 year.

sections.label: Chapter 6
sections.title: Justice on Time
sections.dek: Use AI to sort and speed up every case. Outcome: 2.2 crore cases decided in 1 year, and serious trials finished in 60 days.

sections.label: Part II
sections.title: Unleash Enterprise
sections.dek: Chapters 7 to 11: Free to Build; The Great Repeal; Homes Where the Jobs Are; Built by Indians, Open to the World; Land That Works for Its Owner.

sections.label: Chapter 7
sections.title: Free to Build
sections.dek: One business ID, licence-free business and a 5% import duty. Outcome: a company starts in 1 day, closes in 30 and settles disputes in 90.

sections.label: Chapter 8
sections.title: The Great Repeal
sections.dek: Use AI to repeal outdated laws in one Act. Outcome: about 90% of the legal load gone in 90 days, and every law sunsets in 10 years.

sections.label: Chapter 9
sections.title: Homes Where the Jobs Are
sections.dek: Build homes near jobs and transit, free up renting, and leave no bare ground. Outcome: about 77 lakh new homes, 33 lakh more rentals and permits in 7 days.

sections.label: Chapter 10
sections.title: Built by Indians, Open to the World
sections.dek: Indian control of what is built here, with foreign capital welcome. Outcome: 10% of exports invoiced in rupees in 1 year.

sections.label: Chapter 11
sections.title: Land That Works for Its Owner
sections.dek: Free farmers to lease or sell their land. Outcome: 2 crore leases and 50 lakh acres of modern farms in 1 year.

sections.label: Part III
sections.title: Minimum Government, Maximum Governance
sections.dek: Chapters 12 to 14: A Lean State That Delivers; Clean Money, Trusted Public Life; Leaders Who Run Their Areas Like CEOs.

sections.label: Chapter 12
sections.title: A Lean State That Delivers
sections.dek: Government as a platform, not a provider. Outcome: ₹4 lakh crore raised from sales, 10% fewer posts and ₹38,000 crore a year saved.

sections.label: Chapter 13
sections.title: Clean Money, Trusted Public Life
sections.dek: Public wealth records and faceless audits. Outcome: every political rupee public in 48 hours and ₹30,000 crore a year saved in buying.

sections.label: Chapter 14
sections.title: Leaders Who Run Their Areas Like CEOs
sections.dek: Run every state and district like a company. Outcome: 5 numbers published every quarter, and 200 proven practices copied in 1 year.

sections.label: Part IV
sections.title: Build the Future
sections.dek: Chapters 15 to 20: Every Child a Scientist, Every Door Open to Talent; Backing India's Builders; Defence Startups: Built in India, Proven in the Field; Machines Made in India; Energy: Power Made in India; Built Right, Built to Last.

sections.label: Chapter 15
sections.title: Every Child a Scientist, Every Door Open to Talent
sections.dek: Daily maths, science and coding with AI tutors, in every school of every faith. Outcome: tutors in 22 languages, 1.5 crore tablets and class 3 maths up 5 points.

sections.label: Chapter 16
sections.title: Backing India's Builders
sections.dek: A ₹25,000 crore fund of funds for Indian startups, and crowdfunding for all. Outcome: at least 80 venture funds backed in 1 year.

sections.label: Chapter 17
sections.title: Defence Startups: Built in India, Proven in the Field
sections.dek: The state as guaranteed buyer of Indian defence tech. Outcome: payment in 30 days, ₹8,000 crore committed and 60% Indian drones in 1 year.

sections.label: Chapter 18
sections.title: Machines Made in India
sections.dek: Make machines, robots and chips in India, in 6 sector cities. Outcome: India's first commercial fab, about 1 lakh direct jobs and less of $116 billion of imports.

sections.label: Chapter 19
sections.title: Energy: Power Made in India
sections.dek: Electric vehicles at scale and nuclear power 100x. Outcome: 50,000 e-buses, a charger every 25 km and a path to 880 GW of nuclear.

sections.label: Chapter 20
sections.title: Built Right, Built to Last
sections.dek: Plan once, dig once, build at fair prices with 10-year warranties. Outcome: 100% of broad-gauge rail electric in 1 year and roads left whole for 5 years.

sections.label: Part V
sections.title: A Liveable India
sections.dek: Chapters 21 to 22: Clean Air for Every Lung; Moving a Billion People.

sections.label: Chapter 21
sections.title: Clean Air for Every Lung
sections.dek: A live air sensor everywhere, and polluters pay by the hour. Outcome: PM2.5 down 10% a year, reaching Europe's limit of 10 in about 14 years.

sections.label: Chapter 22
sections.title: Moving a Billion People
sections.dek: One transport authority and a 100-year plan per metro region. Outcome: 1 ticket for every ride, and road deaths halved in 10 years.

sections.label: Part VI
sections.title: People and Society
sections.dek: Chapters 23 to 25: A Hand Up and an Equal Chance; Safe Food, Clean Fields; An Internet That Works for India.

sections.label: Chapter 23
sections.title: A Hand Up and an Equal Chance
sections.dek: Replace subsidies with one cash transfer and one equal-opportunity law. Outcome: ₹3.35 lakh crore a year saved, and bias complaints decided in 30 days.

sections.label: Chapter 24
sections.title: Safe Food, Clean Fields
sections.dek: Ban every pesticide Europe bans, and test food weekly. Outcome: EU food limits in 1 year, and 1 crore hectares moving to organic.

sections.label: Chapter 25
sections.title: An Internet That Works for India
sections.dek: An Indian-first internet that rewards learning. Outcome: endless short-video feeds down 90%, and Indian data kept in India.

sections.label: Part VII
sections.title: Safety and the Rule of Law
sections.dek: Chapters 26 to 27: A Police Force India Can Trust; Safe From Terror, Drugs, Trafficking and Riots.

sections.label: Chapter 26
sections.title: A Police Force India Can Trust
sections.dek: A fit, well-paid, army-style police force. Outcome: 6.2 lakh vacant posts filled, and body cameras on every frontline officer in 1 year.

sections.label: Chapter 27
sections.title: Safe From Terror, Drugs, Trafficking and Riots
sections.dek: The toughest lawful sentences for terror, drugs, trafficking and riots. Outcome: trials in 90 days, every criminal asset seized and riot victims paid in 30 days.

sections.label: Part VIII
sections.title: Making It Law
sections.dek: [Chapter 28](/the-third-freedom/locking-in-the-third-freedom): Locking In the Third Freedom.

sections.label: Chapter 28
sections.title: Locking In the Third Freedom
sections.dek: Every constitutional change in one package. Outcome: passed in 30 days and ratified by the states in 1 year.
